controls.boolean_cases: All8 graphs on3 vertices and all2^12 Boolean assignments for the four-colour encoder
native_cases: K5 four colours UNSAT with checked DRAT

decision: First verified4-UNSAT support becomes a new larger seed. A positive5-colouring certifies exactly five colours; no <=508 claim. If no verified4-UNSAT occurs, finish the fixed24-case batch and checkpoint exact SAT/UNKNOWN outcomes; do not start another batch or refinement loop in this pass.
encoding: Four or five one-hot variables per retained vertex; one at-least-one and every at-most-one pair; equal-colour exclusion on every actual unit edge; lexicographically first retained triangle pinned to0,1,2.
scope: At most24 frozen H632-minus-two-old-vertices trials; stop at first independently checked non-four-colourable support; at most one conditional five-colour query on that same support. No minimization phase.
selection: Remove pairs outside the22 valid old singleton cuts. For each LL/LS/SS stratum sort by (lost unit edges,u,v), greedily take8 vertex-disjoint pairs; interleave LL,LS,SS in rank order. Density heuristic only; no exhaustive exclusion or symmetry quotient claimed.
